create_pid_controller: create a PID controller with custom kp, ki, kd gains and setpoint for animation control
update_pid_output: update the PID controller with a new measurement and timestep to compute the control output
reset_pid_state: reset the PID controller integral and previous measurement state to initial values
call_pid_directly: call the PID controller instance directly with measurement and dt to get the clipped output
configure_pid_limits: configure integral and output limits on the PID controller to clamp control values
